name: single-fixed-development-component-threshold-v1
extraction: Existing stateless largest strictly-above-threshold 8-connected component bounding-box center; first-largest tie; no temporal selection
disposition: Only strictly greater primary visible localization, no increase in false observations, no increase in displaced visible outputs, complete compatible support and unchanged availability justify a separately granted broader temporal experiment; otherwise reject. Never promote from this diagnostic.
limitations: One hypothesis informed by published familiar-development responses; no threshold sweep, optimization or independent evaluation
Agent source assessments are not expert gold labels; unknowns never become negatives
Stateless centers do not measure trajectories, scene continuity, contacts, identities, stroke recognition or complete annotation accuracy
The seven negatives are non-play; no established occlusion or camera-transition support
Historical application motion selection is reported separately from paired stateless extraction
No app/default changes, training, inference, source media/weights downloads or consumed holdout63 access
